units.source_text: 澡塘就是地板下面的石洞。

en.t: The bath was a stone chamber beneath the floor.

units.source_text: 用木板把大水槽隔成三段。

en.t: Wooden boards divided the large water tank into three sections.

units.source_text: 第一段水槽溢出的温泉，流到第二段水槽里，泉水的热度也就渐渐减低了。

en.t: The hot spring water overflowing from the first section flowed into the second section, and the heat of the water gradually decreased.
